name: Loan default predictor
description: Predicts the likelihood of default for loan applicants from their credit history and income. A credit officer makes the final decision.

name: CV shortlisting model
description: Ranks candidates for jobs by scoring their CVs and automatically shortlists the top ten.

name: Demand forecaster
description: Forecasts weekly product demand from aggregate sales data for stock planning.

name: Chest x-ray classifier
description: A convolutional neural network that flags suspected pneumonia on chest x-rays of patients for radiologists to review.

name: Customer churn model
description: Predicts which customers are likely to leave using their usage data to target retention offers.

name: Claims fraud scorer
description: Scores insurance claims for the likelihood of fraud and automatically routes high scores to investigators.

name: Support chatbot
description: A language model chatbot that answers customers' questions about their orders.

name: Predictive maintenance model
description: Detects anomalies in sensor data from machines to schedule maintenance. Uses no personal data.

name: Child safeguarding risk model
description: Predicts which children are at risk of harm from case records and prioritises referrals for social workers.

name: Facial recognition entry system
description: Identifies staff by face recognition at building doors using biometric templates.

name: Meeting summariser
description: A generative model that summarises internal meetings for staff.

name: Energy load forecaster
description: Forecasts energy use of buildings from meter readings. Dashboard for internal use.

name: Exam grading assistant
description: Scores student essays and recommends grades for teachers to confirm. Advisory only.

name: Document classifier
description: Sorts incoming documents into categories using a gradient boosting ensemble.

name: Recidivism risk tool
description: Predicts the risk of re-offending for people on probation to support officers' decisions.

name: Price optimiser
description: Recommends product prices from competitor prices and aggregate demand.

name: Patient readmission predictor
description: Predicts the risk of hospital readmission for patients using clinical records and flags high risk patients to clinicians.

name: Email spam filter
description: Blocks spam emails using a neural network. Runs automatically in real time.

name: Insurance underwriting model
description: Prices policies and automatically approves or refuses applications from applicants' personal data.

name: Voice transcription model
description: Transcribes recorded calls into text for the quality team.

name: Benefit eligibility model
description: Assesses whether a household is eligible for a benefit and recommends an outcome for staff to review.

name: Warehouse route optimiser
description: Plans picking routes in the warehouse using simulation. No personal data.

name: Emotion detection in interviews
description: Detects candidates' emotions from video in interviews to score engagement.

name: Sales lead scorer
description: Scores sales leads from company data to prioritise outreach.

name: Dementia risk model
description: Predicts dementia risk for older adults from health records to prioritise assessments.

name: Image quality checker
description: Checks product photographs for blur before publication.

name: Student dropout predictor
description: Predicts which students are at risk of dropping out from attendance and grades to target support.

name: Translation model
description: Translates letters into other languages for service users. A member of staff reviews each translation.

name: Credit limit model
description: Sets customers' credit limits automatically from their transaction data.

name: Weather forecast model
description: Forecasts local weather from public data for planning outdoor events.
